brief: Garoufalidis & Zagier, Hyperbolic 3-manifolds, the Bloch group, and the work of Walter Neumann — survey of gluing equations, volumes, the extended Bloch group, symplectic properties and quantization.
extended:
**Hyperbolic 3-manifolds, the Bloch group, and the work of Walter Neumann** — Stavros Garoufalidis and Don Zagier.

A survey of Neumann's contributions, organised as: ideal triangulations and the gluing equations; volumes and Dehn surgeries; the Bloch group and the extended Bloch group; symplectic properties; quantization; connections to number theory.

**Why it may bear here.** Every one of those six headings names machinery this corpus uses — gluing equations, hyperbolic volume, the (extended) Bloch group, and the quantization step. As a survey it is the orientation text rather than a source of results.

**Duplicate.** `library/hyperbolicandneumann/` is a second copy of this same document, byte-different but identical in content.
